reviews.title: Annoying disconnect
reviews.text: Great outside of the fact that it disconnects from wifi once a week and has an annoying icon to show that rather than just quietly disconnecting. Every time I look at this frame there’s something in the corner saying it has no wifi connection. I don’t need a constant connection because I sporadically upload photos

reviews.title: Buy the physical digital frame, then watch out.
reviews.text: It’s not enough that you spend the money to buy the digital photo frame from them. Their app that you download to upload the photos is a relentless attack for you to spend more money on the app. What a joke.

reviews.title: Do not Buy
reviews.text: Frameo screen is horrible.  Do not buy this piece of junk.  It stopped working and is just not a good product!

reviews.title: Subscription Disaster
reviews.text:
We bought 2 frames as gifts for grandparents a year or two ago so we could add photos as a family from states away. 

Out of blue… all of a sudden you can’t upload photos remotely without the subscription?  Now the frames are paper weights.  

Guess I’ll have another present idea for Xmas to replace these.  

The app user interface was always difficult to use.

reviews.title: I already bought the frame. I need a PrEmIuM subscription to make it usable. What a joke
reviews.text: Limited to ten photos at a time. If you accidentally select and 11th then you get a frickin pop saying to upgrade to premium. I’ve purchased better frames as gifts and the app with all features was included with no subscription. 100 photo upload limit at a time. Videos with no issue. And you don’t have to manually tell the other ones to fit each individual photo to the frame. Stupid. Would not buy any frame that uses Frameo again. 😡

reviews.title: Paywall for uploading more than 10 photos at once
reviews.text: I have this app to send photos of my son to my grandparents. The app is okey i guess, but putting basic stuff behind paywall rubs me the wrong way. Paywall for uploading more than 10 photos at once. Paywall for deleting old photos. And not pay once but monthly! 17euros per year… why does everyone need suscriptions for basic functionality all the time?!

reviews.title: Screen shots
reviews.text: How do you delete screenshots in the library photos I can’t delete the photos on there I selected a picture and it doesn’t have a trash icon on there to delete it. Can you update the app so it has that feature? Because on my phone app when I tried to do it on there it doesn’t have that feature included please fix that please.

reviews.title: Overly complicated
reviews.text: The app keeps changing the way you sign in. I just want to add some pictures and it takes 20 minutes and ten layers of security. It really seems like they want to know every password and security code you’ve ever used. Feels like data mining.

reviews.title: Brand new frame offline each morning
reviews.text:
I purchased this frame for my special needs brother. It’s a beautiful frame, size is perfect. I have loaded 300 pictures to give him the frame this weekend. I setup the frame to turn off at 8pm and turn on at 7am. When frame turns on in morning it shows offline. Frustrating. The o my way to get back online is to unplug and reboot. Or manually reconnect and type in the wifi password which my brother will NOT be able to do. 

I do not have the same issue with my Uwhale frames.  

I hope the team can provide a firmware update to resolve this issue. Since I have already loaded 300 pictures on - which took time - I don’t want to return. 

Look forward to the team being able to update and address this issue.

reviews.title: Features behind pay wall for a frame you purchased
reviews.text: I won't be purchasing anything from this company ever again. I find it entirely unethical that you spend $60+ to own a frame and they hide features behind a paywall. To me that is pure greed that should never be supported.  I'd be embarrassed if I worked or them, unethical.

reviews.title: Don’t Purchase!!!
reviews.text:
**Absolutely terrible experience.** The primary reason to buy these frames is to easily share photos, and the app completely fails at its only job. 

We have **two separate Frameo frames in our household**, and **both of them have the exact same issue**. I am trying to send photos from an **iPhone using a personal hotspot**, and I constantly get **"failed to send" errors**. 

I have tried every single troubleshooting workaround—including turning on the iPhone's **"Maximize Compatibility"** setting to force a 2.4GHz network—and it still fails completely. The fact that this happens across multiple frames proves it is a buggy, unreliable app issue and not just a one-off hardware defect. The software simply cannot handle hotspot data transfers properly. Save your money and buy a different brand with a functional app. This is a total waste of time and money.

reviews.title: Overrun by greed
reviews.text: Wow, you have to pay to add and remove pics from your phone now? With a product that never works properly? No thanks you greedy pigs

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: So if you think the app controls the frame. Think again, you have to pay extra for that, so the app is free but other than allowing you to send pictures/videos to the frame. The app servers no other purpose. I have owned other frames and all of them had apps that also controlled the frame. NOT this one. If you want delete a picture you need to do it directly on the frame. Any controls reside strictly on the frame. Again unless you want to pay. So free yes, functional NO!

reviews.title: Pantalla táctil dañada
reviews.text: Tengo 1 Frameo y la pantalla no responde al táctil compré otro para recuperar las imágenes en la nube y pasarlas a otro Frameo pero no me deja porque pide confirmación en la pantalla táctil dañada.

reviews.title: Needs permission from frame every time so not good for relatives
reviews.text: Went to send new photos and it’s saying I have to get permission from relatives thousands of miles away to send photos again.  That defeats the purpose of a WiFi photo frame if I need permission every time.

reviews.text: I loved this app & bought 4 additional frames for family. Now it is crashing and won't allow me to open it. I can no longer send photos to any of the frames.

reviews.title: Product is great. App is not.
reviews.text: Love the concept and the project. Constant “UPGRADE NOW” spam. Constantly not recognizing/having to reset password. UI is atrocious and not at all intuitive. The frame is great though!

reviews.title: Problem
reviews.text: Upon opening the app and attempting to delete any duplicate photos.. the app keeps crashing halfway through..

reviews.title: App
reviews.text: Wel wat jammer dat je een frame aanschaft , en dat je als nog moet betalen voor dat beetje meerwaarde in de app. Heel jammer.

reviews.title: Mooi maar…
reviews.text:
Constant verschijnt de melding “inloggen met wifi vereist” terwijl dit al actief is. Als op de melding tik dan verschijnt een “webview browser tester” met de melding “you are now online”
Er is dan geen enkele mogelijkheid om deze browser af te sluiten behalve door de lijst opnieuw op te starten. Waarna dezelfde melding weer oppopt. 
Kan de melding wel afsluiten maar hij komt dagelijks terug. 
Please fix it

reviews.title: Good but greedy

Pay big money for the hardware and then you need a subscription for the bare minimum functionality? Scam. „It allows us to allocate more resources…“. Well, that’s your problem. The frame is expensive enough „to allocate more resources“. Shouldn’t have bought the frame.

reviews.text: Byttet til ny iPhone og nå må man registrere seg for å bruke programmet. Stor nedtur

reviews.title: Waardeloos
reviews.text: Al een aantal jaren hebben we 2 fotolijsten met Frameo. Gratis app, zat bij de prijs van de aankoop van de fotolijst in. Sinds de laatste update gaan ze volledig commercieel en vol voor het geld. Daar kwamen we achter omdat alle video’s op beide lijsten niet meer werkten. Je moet kennelijk een betaald abonnement nemen, dus zeer tegen mijn zijn in ben ik een proefabonnement ingegaan. Maar zelfs dan werken de video’s niet!  Zwaar teleurgesteld; kies niet voor Frameo!!

reviews.text: Wat waardeloos weer, na deze update van vandaag hebben jullie 59 foto’s zodanig door de war gemaakt dat ik ze allemaal moet aanpassen in frame en ja hoor dat gaat natuurlijk weer niet want dan slaat de app weer vast ! Eindelijk liep het aanpassen direct op de telefoon lekker en dan krijg je dit ! Blijf gewoon van mijn foto’s af !! Doe er wat aan want dit is waardeloos !!

reviews.title: No longer delivers (pushed to premium???)
reviews.text: We had a great deal we actually purchased a set of two frames (Sep 2024) it has been working perfectly for the past year until January 11th 2026, I believe after the update. The pictures are not delivering. We have a frame in the states and the other overseas. Nothing has changed from our end only this constant updates. We have the most recent app update, we have tried troubleshooting (everything recommended from the site) - nothing. Idk but losing faith on this app and its frames and might not advise it to get it because it’s frustrating. Main reason was for the grandparents to view pictures from far away, they are not tech savvy and for over a year was perfect then it stopped? And now we are getting notifications to joined the Premium version??? $1.99/mo??? Come on. 👎🏽 Not cool, if they don’t do anything about it by next update. We are getting something similar from another company (perhaps the one they sell at Costco).

reviews.title: Endless popups
reviews.text:
Frameo apps keeps bothering me with popups about Instagram and Tiktok. They pop up multiple times per minute while trying to send photos. 

This is incredibly annoying and dumb because the whole point of using Frameo is to share photos with a selected group of people and avoid apps that use dark patterns. Why redirect users to these other apps?

The "not now" button is a dark patterns in itself because it robs me of the ability to opt out forever.

reviews.title: Frame is cool BUT the app is HORRIBLE
reviews.text: It boggles the mind that it’s my frame, I’m the only one with access but to remove a photo I literally have to sit in front of the frame to do it. That’s a basic function that should not cost extra. The UI is ridiculous, not intuitive. And be careful, when trying to add photos, you can inadvertently select multiple photos without really trying and no way to cancel that. As a IT person I take exception to apps that lack basic usability. If there’s not a third party app to manage this thing I’ll be putting it in the garbage and looking for a different frame.

reviews.title: Layout adjustment
reviews.text: Frameo would be perfect if the layout would adjust itself according to how the owner has the frame positioned (portrait/landscape). This was a gift for my mother as we are far away from her. She said that no matter which way she positions the frame the layout is always cutting off heads or people in the photo. It would be nice, quick, convenient if I didn’t have to adjust each photo everyone I’m sending one. Somedays she will have the photo in the portrait position and other days in the layout position. I don’t want to call her every time I send a new photo to adjust the photo to how she has the frame positioned. Everything else is nice. Pictures seem clear but resolution, definition and sharpness could be better.

reviews.title: Is my frame hacked?!
reviews.text: I was just gifted this and after downloading 170 family photos, weird foreign images and texts appeared on Day 2. My child said he saw it glitching like a broken TV before the screen froze with weird cartoon robot images. I powered it off hoping it was a fluke but on Day 3 something even weirder happened. A ton of blocks with foreign text appeared on the screen and about a minute later a transformer movie trailer played. After the second trailer I powered it off. Now I’m scared to put it back on — not knowing what type of inappropriate videos might play in front of my children AND VERY WORRIED my photos are not private. Is it possibly this is some sort of cyber hack? The frame was purchased brand new from Target and sealed. Please help!

reviews.title: Faulty
reviews.text: After 3 years of use and 5 within the family. All of them turned off around 3 weeks ago and will not come back on. I can’t see anywhere that anyone else is having issues online. Ours are all in different houses therefore on different wifis. All purchased at different times (not all 3 years old) unsure what to do? Any ideas?

reviews.title: Vultures
reviews.text: You have to pay a lot for the frame and then you must pay a subscription just to upload more than 10 photos. Greedy and immoral business practice.

reviews.title: Paywall too low
reviews.text:
Received a frame as a gift and it is nice enough, but the free version of the app is pretty useless. A subscription is required for some pretty basic things (like managing frame images from your phone, and removing a ridiculously low limit of uploading only 10 images at once).
Feels pretty cynical. Don’t feel I can recommend as the app should properly support their product/hardware but doesn’t, and given the subscription model used, it is a pretty poor experience.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: Running on iPad and iPhone. Both apps very glitchy. Constantly freezing and showing white screen. Have upgraded to paid version and no different. Sending 100 photos at a time to Frame and they don’t arrive on Frame. Is there a limit to how many I can send a day? Poor if there is, expected better.

reviews.title: Don’t buy it
reviews.text: Nothing works. Feels really cheap and is!  Complete waste of money. Only gave it one star because I couldn’t give it 0 but it’s really only fit for the bin.

reviews.title: Difficult to use
reviews.text: This app is very difficult to use. You can only send up to 10 photos at a time. When you want to go back into your photos to send more you must go through your photos and uncheck the ones you’ve already sent or they will upload again. There is no way to see what photos you’ve already uploaded while also checking new photos to send unless you are in front of the frame to view the ones you’ve already uploaded. I have not found a way to select portrait or landscape for each photo. Uploaded photos end up not displaying in full. Supposedly you can adjust your image before uploading but it doesn’t always work. Some pictures display with people cut off at the top or bottom or both. Once they are uploaded you can’t fix them. Printed instructions are useless. This app needs to be re-engineered to be more user friendly.
